tools.name: delete_saved_address_book_entry
tools.description: Permanently deletes a saved contact address from the wallet's address book, along with its label and notes. The entry cannot be recovered afterward.

params.name: wallet_id
params.description: ID of the wallet that owns the address book

params.name: entry_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the address book entry to remove

tools.code:
import sqlite3

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("wallet-tools")

DB_PATH = "wallet.db"


@mcp.tool()
def delete_saved_address_book_entry(wallet_id: str, entry_id: int) -> dict:
    result = {
        "wallet_id": wallet_id,
        "entry_id": entry_id,
        "deleted": False,
        "removed_entry": None,
        "error": None,
    }

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT id, label, address, chain, notes FROM address_book WHERE id = ? AND wallet_id = ?",
            (entry_id, wallet_id),
        ).fetchone()

        if row is None:
            result["error"] = "entry not found"
            return result

        result["removed_entry"] = {
            "label": row["label"],
            "address": row["address"],
            "chain": row["chain"],
            "has_notes": bool(row["notes"]),
        }

        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM address_book WHERE id = ? AND wallet_id = ?",
            (entry_id, wallet_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
        result["deleted"] = cur.rowcount > 0
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        result["error"] = str(exc)
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return result
